description:
A 7-inch 45 RPM single by Kenny Rogers and the First Edition on the orange Reprise Records “Back to Back Hits” label with the riverboat logo. One side is the classic “Ruby, Don’t Take Your Love to Town,” written by Mel Tillis, produced by Jimmy Bowen, and arranged by Glen D. Hardin. The other side is the story-song favorite “Reuben James,” written by Harvey and Etris and arranged and produced by Mike Post. It comes in an olive gold Philadelphia International Records “The Sound of Philadelphia” company sleeve with the bold magenta logo. It would make a great addition to a country or country-pop 45 collection, a jukebox, or a retro music display.
Details:
Style: 7-inch 45 RPM Back to Back Hits single in a company paper sleeve
Color: Black vinyl with an orange Reprise label and riverboat logo, plus an olive gold sleeve with magenta and brown print
Size: About 7 in across (see tape measure photo)
Marks: Reprise Back to Back Hits 0738; L6669 (Ruby, Don’t Take Your Love to Town, 2:52, Spring ‘69) and M17354 (Reuben James, 2:44, Fall ‘69); Made in U.S.A.
Condition:
The record is flat and keeps a glossy finish. The vinyl has light surface scuffs and faint handling marks that show under light, plus a small mark near the label on the “Reuben James” side. Both labels are bright, with sharp, readable print and no writing or stickers. There are a few small dark specks near the center hole on the “Ruby” side. The Philadelphia International sleeve is not the original Reprise sleeve. It has light toning, soft creasing, a small white mark near one top corner, and light wear along the edges and corners. It still holds and protects the record well. Please review all photos. Sold as shown.

shipping.policy:
We use FedEx as our contracted shipping carrier and follow their packaging guidelines. Keep in mind, FedEx now uses a volumetric calculation to determine shipping estimates. This is called
dimensional weight
and refers to the amount of space a package occupies in relation to its actual weight. For more information regarding dimensional weight, please visit:
https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/packaging/what-is-dimensional-weight.html
.
Once payment has cleared, orders are generally processed within 5 business days, not including weekends or holidays.
Goodwill Industries of the Inland Northwest will not be held liable for lost or stolen packages if they are marked
delivered
within the tracking details. It is the responsibility of the customer to contact the shipping carrier to inquire about the claims process for reimbursement. We are happy to provide the necessary paperwork to facilitate this process.
Purchased items will be shipped as specified within the order. We are unable to reroute packages once processed. Please ensure any address changes are made prior to payment during the checkout process. Per FedEx policies, we cannot accept P.O. boxes, please provide us with a physical address.
Buyers may also arrange their own third-party shipping service for pick-up only items. However, the carrier must assume all responsibility for the item and must be able to retrieve, pack, and ship. Please submit a customer service ticket for inquiry.
Combined shipping
Due to automation, items can only be combined prior to payment being received. Eligible items must meet the following criteria:
The items are from the same Goodwill location.
The items close within the same week.
You have not already paid for any of the items.
The combined weight does not exceed 20 pounds.
Items are not already in a fixed-price, flat-rate shipping box.
Items can't be purchased via buy-it-now or with 1 cent shipping.
You will be automatically prompted to combine all available items during checkout. If the site does not, please submit a customer service ticket for inquiry; some exceptions may be made.

description: Pair of natural chalcedony filled geode specimens with a combined weight of 262.5 grams. The smaller geode measures 2.5x2x1.25 inches and features a chalcedony layer over an agate layer. The larger geode measures 3.5x3x1.25 inches and includes azurite patches on the back. Both geodes have rough tan and brown exteriors with some blue mineral deposits. Interiors reveal crystalline formations; one with clear and white crystals, the other with banded brown and purple hues and white crystals. Specimens are unpolished with natural textures and colors, suitable for collectors, educational purposes, or decorative use. No visible damage to crystal interiors.

description:
Natural Agate Geode Specimen
Mounted Mineral Display on Iron Base
Agate, Quartz, Iron, 5.5 Inches
This natural agate geode slice is mounted on a minimalist black iron pedestal stand, highlighting its natural crystallization and banded formations. Geodes form within gas cavities of volcanic rock, where silica-rich groundwater gradually precipitates chalcedony bands and quartz crystals over millions of years. Display pieces mounted on museum-style metal stands are sought after for modern interiors, geological collections, and natural history displays.
Polished front face showcasing concentric agate banding around a druzy quartz cavity
Crystal pocket features sparkling quartz points with dark mineral inclusions
Natural rough reddish-brown matrix rind preserved along the curved back
Mounted on a black finished iron rod and rectangular metal base with rubber foot pads
Measures 5.5 inches high by 3 inches long by 2 inches wide; weighs 1 lb
Condition:
Geological formation is structurally sound with no repaired breaks. Polished face is smooth with natural internal fissures typical of agate. Black iron base shows minor light edge wear and a small paint chip along the front margin. Retains original inventory sticker on the underside.

: Discover a captivating lot of eight unique mineral rock and crystal geode specimens, perfect for collectors and enthusiasts alike. All items exhibit visible raw form, with minor edge irregularities typical of authentic mineral samples. Description:
This bundle presents a diverse collection of crystal and mineral rocks, ideal for collectors, learners, or as decorative accents. The set includes various natural specimens, such as polished geode halves displaying distinct striated patterns, crystalline clusters with glimmering surfaces, and notable mineral samples. Two labeled display cards are included, featuring mounted specimens: one card lists anthracite coal, banded sandstone, copper ore, granite, and marble; the other card displays amethyst, carnelian, jade (missing piece), milky quartz, and tiger eye. Each stone is unique in coloration, texture, and shape, providing both visual appeal and educational value. The assortment will enhance any decor, spark curiosity in geology, or serve as a tactile teaching aid. The items are in used condition with minor handling wear and the jade piece is missing from the display card. Overall, this bundle showcases visually striking and varied stones, suitable for display, collecting, or gifting to crystal enthusiasts. Category: Collectibles & Art

Goodwill Industries of Ventura & Santa Barbara Counties is not responsible for items that are lost or stolen after the carrier confirms delivery. Items marked as delivered to the address provided become the responsibility of the buyer. Any delivery concerns must be directed to the shipping carrier.
Orders typically ship within
5 business days
after payment clears (excluding weekends and holidays).
All shipments are sent
via FedEx only
, following FedEx packaging standards.
Orders over $100 require signature confirmation upon delivery.
Combined Shipping
Items that are not eligible for combined shipping are determined, at our discretion, to pose a risk of damage if shipped together.
Requests for combined shipping must be submitted
before payment
via a customer service ticket.
Once payment is completed, orders
cannot be modified or combined
.
Buy It Now Non-Auction items and Stock Items are not eligible for combined shipping.
ART with glass is not eligible for combined shipping regardless of whether or not the system lets you combine them!
NOTE:
It is buyers' responsibility to evaluate whether or not the items could be safely combined! The system may "LET" you combine items, but should you combine a 13 LB bowling ball with a 2 LB vase?
Buyer will be responsible for damages of combined shipping items.
Local Pickup Policy
All items are available for local pickup.
Scheduling & Payment
Pickup appointments are
required
and must be scheduled through the Pickup Scheduler on ShopGoodwill or in the app.
All orders must be paid in full prior to pickup.
No payments are accepted at the time of pickup.
Pickup Hours
Monday–Saturday:
8:00 AM – 3:00 PM (PST)
Closed for lunch:
11:00 AM – 12:00 PM
Please arrive on time. If delayed, notify us through a customer service ticket.
Items must be picked up within
14 calendar days of payment
. Items not collected within this period are considered
abandoned & re-donated
and are relisted
without refund
.
Buyers may arrange third-party pickup or delivery for large or “Pickup Only” items. The carrier must be able to pack, load, and transport the item and assumes full responsibility. Please submit a customer service ticket for coordination.
No pets allowed
, except service animals.
Pickup Location
Goodwill Industries of Ventura & Santa Barbara Counties
Goodwill Outlet
1401 N. Rice Ave
Oxnard, CA 93030
(Entrance on Maulhardt — Check in with the Outlet Cashier)
Returns & Refunds
All items are sold
AS-IS
and are
non-refundable
, except in cases of:
Damage occurring during shipment, or
Gross misrepresentation.
All returns require
prior approval
.
Requests must be submitted within
5 days of delivery
via the customer service ticketing system.
Shipping-damage claims must include clear photos of both the item
and
original packaging.
Returns will be denied if the item has been altered, tampered with, or modified after shipment.
Authenticated Items
If this auction has been authenticated by a third-party vendor, the Title or Description may state w/COA or Authenticated however it Does NOT come with physical COA.
COA is only emailed upon request.
Items authenticated by third-party providers include a
$9.99 handling fee
.
Customer Service
Hours:
Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 3:00 PM (PST)
For assistance, submit a customer service ticket through your account or use the
Contact Seller
link on the listing.
We aim to respond within
2 business days
. Closure of a ticket indicates a response has been issued and does not necessarily indicate final resolution.
